title: Enzymes arrive from a neighbor
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: The pancreas produces digestive enzymes and enzyme precursors that enter the small intestine in pancreatic juice.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which accessory organ produces pancreatic amylase, lipase and protease precursors for delivery to the small intestine? The pancreas produces digestive enzymes and enzyme precursors that enter the small intestine in pancreatic juice.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
